Finder scans16 active32-byte field records, abs((x-recordx)>>8)<=7 and same fory, compares key halfword+8; returns pointer orNULL.
Queue helper rejects count>49 before pointer dereference; otherwise tag155 payload is u16 returned-record+C zeroextended, one8-byte chunk. No caller null guard exists.
Receiver(tag-0x81)==0x1A binds tag155 to5D4C4((u16)payload0), established field-item removal consumer.
